description: This file defines the 'RelationshipType' class in Java, representing a type of relationship between two people within the OpenMRS health records system. It includes metadata about the relationship, such as direction, weight, and whether it's preferred.

classes.name: RelationshipType
classes.description: Represents a bidirectional relationship type between patients or persons in the OpenMRS system, with attributes such as description, weight, direction labels, and preference status.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this relationship type.

methods.name: setRelationshipTypeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this relationship type.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight associated with the relationship type, potentially used for ordering or significance.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight for this relationship type.

methods.name: getaIsToB
methods.description: Returns the label describing how entity A relates to entity B.

methods.name: setaIsToB
methods.description: Sets the label describing how entity A relates to entity B.

methods.name: getbIsToA
methods.description: Returns the label describing how entity B relates to entity A.

methods.name: setbIsToA
methods.description: Sets the label describing how entity B relates to entity A.

methods.name: getPreferred
methods.description: Returns whether this relationship type is marked as preferred.

methods.name: setPreferred
methods.description: Sets the preferred status of this relationship type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation combining the direction labels of the relationship.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements Abstract method to get the ID, returning relationshipTypeId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implements Abstract method to set the ID, assigning to relationshipTypeId.
